data.title: Solar System Explorer
data.description: Discover the planets that make up our neighborhood in space. Watch them move and learn about each unique world.

bodies.name: Sun
bodies.description: The Sun is our star! It's a giant ball of hot gas that gives us light and warmth.
bodies.funFact: The Sun is so big that over 1 million Earths could fit inside it!

bodies.name: Mercury
bodies.description: Mercury is a rocky world covered in craters.
bodies.funFact: Mercury zips around the Sun in just 88 days.

bodies.name: Venus
bodies.description: Venus is covered in thick, cloudy layers.
bodies.funFact: A day on Venus is longer than its year!

bodies.name: Earth
bodies.description: Earth is our home planet with liquid water and life.
bodies.funFact: Earth is the only planet not named after a god or goddess!

bodies.name: Mars
bodies.description: Mars is a rocky world with dusty red soil.
bodies.funFact: Mars looks red because its soil contains rusty iron!

bodies.name: Jupiter
bodies.description: Jupiter is a giant world made mostly of swirling gases.
bodies.funFact: Jupiter has a famous giant storm called the Great Red Spot.

bodies.name: Saturn
bodies.description: Saturn is a gas giant surrounded by prominent rings.
bodies.funFact: Saturn's beautiful rings are made of ice and rock.

bodies.name: uranus
bodies.description: Uranus is an icy world that rotates on its side.
bodies.funFact: Uranus rolls around the Sun like a ball.

bodies.name: Neptune
bodies.description: Neptune is a cold, windy, and distant blue world.
bodies.funFact: Neptune has some of the strongest winds in the solar system.

bodies.name: Pluto
bodies.description: Pluto is a small, icy dwarf planet in the distant reaches of space.
bodies.funFact: Pluto has a large heart-shaped region on its surface.
